title: A lumped body cooling by radiation alone: a cube from 1000 K to surroundings at 300 K and to 0 K
source: The lumped capacitance method with radiation alone, ρ c V dT/dt = −ε σ A (T⁴ − T_sur⁴), integrated in closed form: t = ρ c V / (4 ε σ A T_sur³) {ln|(T_sur + T)/(T_sur − T)| − ln|(T_sur + T₀)/(T_sur − T₀)| + 2 [atan(T/T_sur) − atan(T₀/T_sur)]}, and t = ρ c V / (3 ε σ A) (1/T³ − 1/T₀³) for surroundings at 0 K (F. P. Incropera, D. P. DeWitt, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, §5.3, the general lumped capacitance analysis); T(t) solved by bisection to round-off. One hex8 keeps a uniform temperature (each node's capacity and radiating area are the same eighth), so the finite element model is the lumped body whatever its conductivity
